players.product: Front-end photoresist coater/developer tracks (offline, I-line, KrF, ArF immersion), front-end single-wafer chemical and physical cleaning tools, and advanced-packaging coater/developer, wet and temporary bonding/debonding tools

quarterly_data.quarter: Kingsemi results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (06-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Dong Boyu (results briefing): Q1 2026 revenue was RMB 3.31 hundred million, up 20% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 350.89 ten-thousand, down 25%, mainly because costs and expenses rose with the company's growing scale and lower government subsidies cut other income. He said Q1 new orders grew relatively fast year on year and the order momentum is good.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue RMB 3.31 hundred million (+20%); net profit attributable RMB 350.89 ten-thousand (-25%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Kingsemi results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (06-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Dong Boyu (results briefing, FY2025 review and outlook): front-end chemical cleaning contributed revenue for the first time in 2025 and he expects its share of revenue to keep rising as orders continue and delivery and acceptance speed up; back-end and small-size tools held a roughly flat share, within which bonding tools' revenue and share rose sharply; front-end Track revenue grew. 2025 new orders kept growing fast - the new chemical cleaner has been fully introduced at several leading domestic wafer fabs and won batch repeat orders from some customers, and he expects chemical cleaning to keep growing well over the next few years; its high-end cleaners have secured positions and started to ramp, with orders growing quickly, and the company will use NAURA group synergies to raise its share at customers. 2025 operating cash flow was RMB 1.03 hundred million, lower year on year, as material stocking rose with order growth and pay rose with headcount. Since NAURA became controlling shareholder in June 2025, the company is concentrating resources to strive for a rapid breakthrough in front-end Track over the next few years, and it expects its back-end products (temporary bonding, debonding, Frame cleaning) to keep benefiting as customers deepen CoWoS, HBM and 3DIC build-outs.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 operating cash flow RMB 1.03 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: Kingsemi results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (06-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Profitability (results briefing): Chairman Dong Boyu said the profit decline reflects heavy R&D and talent investment in new-generation coater/developers, high-end chemical cleaners, advanced-packaging tools and core components, rising management and sales expenses as new-product orders grow fast, the lag between R&D, orders and revenue, plus government subsidies not received on schedule and FX losses; the company runs a company-wide cost-reduction and efficiency plan. Board secretary Liu Shujie said revenue scale is still small and the blended product gross margin relatively low, and the company expects profitability to recover somewhat as scale grows; it aims to cut core-component costs through joint development, in-house development and alternative suppliers, and to lower sales and management expense ratios.
